# AssetCategories

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors.SceneBuilding` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Editor/SceneBuilder/AssetSources/IAssetSource.cs#L18)

The kinds of asset the Assets category deals in. Kept to the three things a scene is
actually built out of - a model you place, a sound you hear, a texture you dress something
with. Materials, shaders, animation clips and the like are authoring inputs, not scene
content, so the browser does not list them.
Sources are free to use their own [`Category`](/api/vrframework-core-editors-scenebuilding/AssetEntry#category) values for finer
grouping ("Furniture", "Tools"); these are the names the built-in sources and the icon
lookup agree on.
